data.name: Deep Space Exodus
data.detailed_description:
Deep Space Exodus is a sci-fi, multi-ending narrative simulation game set against the backdrop of deep-space navigation.
You alone bear the fate of an immigrant starship, making irreversible decisions again and again in the boundless universe.

You Are the Administrator of The Noah

As the sole decision-making core of the immigrant starship The Noah, the future of hundreds—perhaps thousands—of lives rests on your judgment.
During this long and lonely voyage, there are no “correct answers.”
There are only consequences.

Explore the Unknown Depths of Space

Throughout your journey, you will continuously encounter the unknown:

  • Unfamiliar planets of vastly different natures — each may offer hope, or conceal a deadly trap

  • Other starships and interstellar travelers — will you ignore them, cooperate, or confront them? A choice must always be made

  • Mysterious signals from deep space — are they cries for help, warnings, or bait? The universe will not explain. It will only wait for your response.

The voyage is never peaceful. Crises can strike at any moment:

  • 🏴‍☠ Sudden attacks by space pirates

  • 🛰 Secrets hidden within abandoned space stations

  • ☄ Unpredictable stellar storms

  • ❓ Incomprehensible anomalies and critical moments of decision

Every event forces you to choose between risk, cost, and humanity.

Resource Management: The Core Law of Survival

Resources are time. Resources are life.

  • ⚡ Energy — the foundation of propulsion, life support, and exploration

  • 📦 Supplies — how long your crew can endure

  • 👥 Population — labor, hope, and burden alike

Resources are always limited, and problems are always greater than what you can afford.
You must decide what takes priority—and what can be sacrificed.

Every Choice Shapes the Ending

There is no linear storyline.
There is no predefined perfect ending.
There are only outcomes shaped by your own decisions.

Remember: every choice you make may determine the historical course of an entire civilization.

data.short_description: Deep Space Exodus is a sci-fi narrative simulation with multiple endings. You manage The Noah, an immigrant starship searching for a new home. Face unprecedented cosmic events, allocate energy, supplies, and population, and decide the fate of an entire civilization.
